title: Mitigate tracer client overhead via dynamic sampling buckets and hot-path allocation fixes
creator: Marco Chen
description: Short summary: Tracer client is adding measurable CPU and memory overhead at high QPS. Workstream: implement dynamic per-service sampling buckets, move tail-sampling to background processor, and fix hot-path allocations in the tracer to reduce per-request cost. Benefits: reduce tracer-induced latency and resource usage while preserving capture of tail/error traces for debugging and SLOs.
acceptance_criteria: CPU consumption by tracer reduced by >=20% at 50k QPS workload
Heap allocation from tracer reduced by >=15% on benchmark harness
End-to-end p99 request latency increase from tracer <=5ms (target <=2ms)
Tail/error capture rate >=99% for errors and >=95% for requests above p99 latency after sampling
Rolling deploy to 10% then 50% with monitoring and rollback plan passes canary for 72h
design_notes: Prototype uses per-service 'sampling buckets' with adaptive rate decays based on recent trace volume
Hybrid head+deferred-tail sampling: initial cheap head decision, record minimal metadata, background worker re-evaluates and persists full spans for tail/errors
Bounded async span buffer with backpressure and circuit-breaker to avoid uncontrolled memory amplification
Memory/perf fixes: reuse byte buffers, reduce map use in span tags, avoid expensive string allocations in hot path
Flag-gated rollout and metrics to measure sampling fidelity and overhead
implementation_plan: 1) Add per-service sampling config and runtime buckets (agent + control-plane hooks)
2) Implement low-allocation head sampling fast-path in tracer client
3) Implement background tail sampler worker with bounded queue and async persistence
4) Add canary flag and integrate with runtime feature flags
5) Update dashboards and alerts, run benchmark harness
6) Gradual rollout and observe metrics; iterate on sampling thresholds
comments: 2025-02-11 Marco Chen: Initial profiling on staging-3 shows tracer allocations concentrated in span.CopyTags() and metadata string concatenation; attached flamegraph link.

2025-02-13 Daniel Kim: Reviewed design; recommended explicit backpressure and a 'sampling-saturation' gauge to avoid silent drops. Suggested moving stringify operations to background worker.
2025-02-15 Priya Patel: Pushed prototype PR #4321 implementing per-service buckets and fast-path sampling; microbenchmarks show 18% CPU reduction and 12% heap reduction at 30k QPS.
2025-02-16 QA: Load test on canary-1 (10% traffic) for 6h. Observed traces_sampled_ratio stable; tail_error_capture_rate 98.6% (slightly below target). Investigating threshold tuning.
2025-02-17 Marco Chen: Reduced default head sample rate for high-volume services and increased tail re-evaluation window; re-ran benchmarks showing tail_error_capture_rate 99.3% and CPU -22%.
2025-02-18 Security: Quick review - no new secrets introduced; KMS unaffected. Marked security_review_required=false.
